You first reported the kiosks offline at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug** in #inc-vtg-hartford. That message says both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan, and the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard.

The channel has no other guard activity until 11:03 AM, when Mateo reported that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. Your 11:08 AM update says both lanes were working as of 11:07.
